paragraphs.text: Moves the DSH temp cache to a configurable directory and cleans it with an allowlist; manages archiv
ed sessions and workspace temp folders. Bilingual (EN/ZH). MIT.
# dsh-cache-cleaner
**English** | 简体中文
Move the DeepSeek Harness temp cache to a configurable location, clean it with a strict allowlist, a
nd manage archived sessions and workspace temp/archive folders — from a settings panel, CLI, or agen
e archived sessions and workspace temp/archive folders — from a settings panel, CLI, or agent tools.
> The plugin is **bilingual**: the settings panel follows the DSH UI language, and every agent-tool
description carries both English and Chinese text.
## Features
- **Cache relocation** — the plugin redirects the host process's `TEMP`/`TMP` (and therefore `os.tmp
dir()` and child processes) to `<cacheRoot>/temp`. New session snapshots stop landing on the system

drive.
- **Allowlisted cleanup** — only `dsh-workspace-changes-*/objects/<2 hex>/tmp_obj_<6 chars>`
files are removable. `captures/`, sha1 objects, lock files, sessions, config and credentials are nev

er touched.
- **Two gates** — age (default 14 days) and quota (when the cache exceeds 50 GiB, evict
oldest-first down to 80%). Legacy `%TEMP%/dsh-workspace-changes-*` directories are handled separatel

y with a 24-hour minimum age.
- **Archived sessions** — list archived sessions, preview a deletion p
lan, then delete a session together with (or without) its artifacts: attachments and the session pro
jection cache. Deletion goes through the host's own registry APIs; a live session is always refused.
- **Workspace roots** — report and (optionally) clean direct children of configured temp/archive fo

lders using each subtree's newest mtime. Archives are report-only until explicitly enabled.
- **Sett
ings panel** — a **缓存清理 / Cache cleaner** section under Settings with overview, cache, workspace, ar
chived sessions and cleanup options; the panel renders immediately and fills data in as background s

cans finish.
- **7 agent tools** — `cache_status`, `cache_clean`, `cache_ownership`, `conversation_l
ist`, `conversation_delete`, `workspace_status`, `workspace_clean`.

## Configuration
All keys are optional. Set them by editing the plugin entry's `config` in your profile's `cordis.pat
ch.yml` (Settings → Plugins → cache cleaner also persists the cleanup options).
| Key | Default | Meaning |
| `cacheRoot` | Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-cache-cleaner`; others: `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dsh-cache-clea
ner` or `~/.cache/dsh-cache-cleaner` | Root for the redirected temp dir and reports. Put it on a dri

ve with free space. |
| `redirectTemp` | `true` | Redirect `TEMP`/`TMP` for the host process. |
| `a

utoClean` | `true` | Run the scheduled cleanup (startup delay + interval + idle debounce). |
| `auto

CleanLegacy` | `false` | Include legacy `%TEMP%/dsh-workspace-changes-*` dirs in automatic runs. |
|

`startupDelaySeconds` | `60` | Delay before the first automatic run. |
| `intervalHours` | `6` | Sc

heduled scan interval (UI presets: 1/3/7/15/30 days). |
| `idleQuietMinutes` | `10` | Extra run afte

r the agent has been idle this long. |
| `mode` | `normal` | `safe` (30 d / 50 GiB), `normal` (14 d

/ 50 GiB), `aggressive` (1 d / 30 GiB). |
| `retainDays` | `null` | Override the mode's age gate. |

| `quotaBytes` | `null` | Override the mode's quota gate. |
| `workspaceBases` | `[]` | Directories

that configured workspace roots must live strictly inside. |
| `workspaceRoots` | `[]` | `[{path, ki

nd: temp\|archive, retainDays, auto}]`; only direct children are considered. |
| `manageArchives` |
`false` | Master switch for deleting `kind: archive` roots. |

## Safety model
- **Allowlist only** — anything not matching the tmp-object pattern is left alone; symlinks and junc

tions are never followed or deleted.
- **Dry-run by default** — CLI and tools report a plan unless `
--apply` / `apply:true`. Applying requires `confirm:true`; archive roots additionally require `manag

eArchives:true` and `includeArchives:true`.
- **Root marker** — cleanup refuses a `cacheRoot` withou
t the `.dsh-cache-cleaner.json` marker (written by `--init` or the plugin), so a mistyped root canno

t be swept.
- **Path fences** — workspace roots must be strictly inside a configured base; volume ro

ots, the home directory, `DSH_HOME` and the cache root are rejected.
- **Real-space check** — the cl
eaner compares free space before/after and reports any gap (for example a safe-delete implementation

that redirects files to the recycle bin).
- **Failures are isolated** — one undeletable file is rep
orted as `skipped` with its path and errno; the rest of the batch continues.
## Tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `cache_status` | Redirect state, roots, sizes, legacy dirs, timers, last report (read-only). |
| `

cache_clean` | Clean cache temp objects; default dry-run. |
| `cache_ownership` | Attribute cache te
mp dirs to sessions by creation-time window (reported as `confidence: "time-window"`; the format has

no persistent ownership). |
| `conversation_list` | List archived sessions (size, workspace, first

message, projection cache). |
| `conversation_delete` | Plan or delete archived sessions; `includeAr

tifacts` adds attachments/projection cache; `includeTempDirs` adds time-window temp dirs. |
| `works

pace_status` | Report configured workspace roots and stale direct children. |
| `workspace_clean` |
Remove stale direct children; archive roots are gated. |
## CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Offline registry edits (when the host is not running) require `--offline-registry`; the CLI writes a
timestamped `.bak-<ms>` before touching `workspace.json`, and refuses without the flag.
## Honesty boundaries
- Temp-directory ownership is **inferred from a creation-time window**, not stored by the host; the

report labels it `confidence: "time-window"`.
- Attachment and projection-cache ownership is exact:

a shared attachment referenced by a retained session is never deleted.
- The host has no session-del
ete API; deletion removes the log directory and then uses `unarchiveSession` + detach on the workspa

ce registry. Untracked/ghost sessions have no registry entry to clean.
